question_text: Construct a logic diagram for Z=(NOT P) OR (Q AND (NOT R)), using standard symbols for each gate.
adaptation_rationale: Constructing standard-gate diagram from expression explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: P→NOT; R→NOT; Q and NOT R→AND; NOT P and AND output→OR→Z.

marking_points.criterion: AND receives Q and NOT R.
OR combines NOT P with AND output and labels Z.
